## Publications {#publications}

```{r, results='asis'}
library(knitr)

bib_path <- "publications-ielbadisy.bib"

html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

clean_tex <- function(x) {
  replacements <- c(
    "\\\\`A" = "À", "\\\\`E" = "È", "\\\\`I" = "Ì", "\\\\`O" = "Ò", "\\\\`U" = "Ù",
    "\\\\`a" = "à", "\\\\`e" = "è", "\\\\`i" = "ì", "\\\\`o" = "ò", "\\\\`u" = "ù",
    "\\\\'A" = "Á", "\\\\'E" = "É", "\\\\'I" = "Í", "\\\\'O" = "Ó", "\\\\'U" = "Ú",
    "\\\\'a" = "á", "\\\\'e" = "é", "\\\\'i" = "í", "\\\\'o" = "ó", "\\\\'u" = "ú",
    "\\\\`c" = "ç", "\\\\c\\{c\\}" = "ç", "\\\\c\\{C\\}" = "Ç",
    "\\\\\"a" = "ä", "\\\\\"e" = "ë", "\\\\\"i" = "ï", "\\\\\"o" = "ö", "\\\\\"u" = "ü",
    "\\\\\"A" = "Ä", "\\\\\"E" = "Ë", "\\\\\"I" = "Ï", "\\\\\"O" = "Ö", "\\\\\"U" = "Ü",
    "\\\\&" = "&", "\\\\%" = "%", "\\\\#" = "#", "\\\\_" = "_"
  )
  for (pat in names(replacements)) {
    x <- gsub(pat, replacements[[pat]], x, perl = TRUE)
  }
  x <- gsub("[{}]", "", x)
  x <- gsub("~", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  trimws(x)
}

parse_bib <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
  entries <- list()
  current <- character()

  for (line in lines) {
    if (grepl("^@", line)) {
      if (length(current)) entries[[length(entries) + 1]] <- current
      current <- line
    } else if (length(current)) {
      current <- c(current, line)
    }
  }
  if (length(current)) entries[[length(entries) + 1]] <- current

  parse_one <- function(entry_lines) {
    header <- entry_lines[1]
    m <- regexec("^@([[:alpha:]]+)\\{([^,]+),", header)
    mm <- regmatches(header, m)[[1]]
    fields <- list(
      type = tolower(mm[2]),
      key = mm[3]
    )

    body <- entry_lines[-1]
    body <- body[!grepl("^\\s*\\}$", body)]

    for (line in body) {
      if (!grepl("=", line, fixed = TRUE)) next
      m2 <- regexec("^\\s*([[:alnum:]_]+)\\s*=\\s*(.*?)(,?)\\s*$", line, perl = TRUE)
      mm2 <- regmatches(line, m2)[[1]]
      if (length(mm2) < 3) next
      field <- tolower(mm2[2])
      value <- mm2[3]
      value <- sub(",\\s*$", "", value)
      value <- sub('^"(.*)"$', "\\1", value)
      value <- sub("^\\{(.*)\\}$", "\\1", value)
      fields[[field]] <- clean_tex(value)
    }

    fields
  }

  parsed <- lapply(entries, parse_one)
  names(parsed) <- vapply(parsed, `[[`, character(1), "key")
  parsed
}

fmt_name <- function(name) {
  name <- clean_tex(name)
  parts <- trimws(strsplit(name, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  if (length(parts) >= 2) {
    paste(c(parts[-1], parts[1]), collapse = " ")
  } else {
    name
  }
}

fmt_authors <- function(author, max_authors = 3) {
  if (is.null(author) || !nzchar(author)) return("")
  authors <- strsplit(author, "\\s+and\\s+", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  authors <- vapply(authors, fmt_name, character(1))
  if (length(authors) > max_authors) {
    authors <- c(authors[seq_len(max_authors)], "et al.")
  }
  text <- paste(authors, collapse = ", ")
  text <- gsub("Imad El Badisy", "<strong>Imad El Badisy</strong>", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text
}

venue_for <- function(entry) {
  if (!is.null(entry$journal) && nzchar(entry$journal)) return(entry$journal)
  if (!is.null(entry$booktitle) && nzchar(entry$booktitle)) return(entry$booktitle)
  if (!is.null(entry$publisher) && nzchar(entry$publisher)) return(entry$publisher)
  ""
}

entry_text <- function(entry) {
  title <- if (!is.null(entry$title)) html_escape(entry$title) else ""
  venue <- if (!nzchar(venue_for(entry))) "" else paste0("<em>", html_escape(venue_for(entry)), "</em>")
  authors <- if (!is.null(entry$author)) fmt_authors(entry$author) else ""
  year <- if (!is.null(entry$year)) entry$year else ""
  paste0(
    "<tr>",
    "<td>", year, "</td>",
    "<td>", authors, "</td>",
    "<td>", title, "</td>",
    "<td>", venue, "</td>",
    "</tr>"
  )
}

entry_key <- function(entry) {
  paste(
    tolower(if (!is.null(entry$title)) entry$title else ""),
    tolower(venue_for(entry)),
    sep = " "
  )
}

is_article <- function(entry) {
  if (entry$type != "article") return(FALSE)
  title <- if (!is.null(entry$title)) tolower(entry$title) else ""
  venue <- tolower(venue_for(entry))
  if (grepl("^package\\s", title)) return(FALSE)
  if (grepl("conference abstracts|colloque|iscb|epiclin|medai", paste(title, venue, collapse = " "), ignore.case = TRUE)) return(FALSE)
  TRUE
}

is_communication <- function(entry) {
  title <- if (!is.null(entry$title)) tolower(entry$title) else ""
  venue <- tolower(venue_for(entry))
  entry$type == "inproceedings" ||
    grepl("conference abstracts|colloque|iscb|epiclin|medai", paste(title, venue, collapse = " "), ignore.case = TRUE) ||
    grepl("^co[0-9]+", title, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

sorted_entries <- function(entries) {
  entries <- entries[order(
    -as.integer(vapply(entries, function(e) if (!is.null(e$year)) e$year else "0", character(1))),
    vapply(entries, entry_key, character(1))
  )]
  entries
}

bib <- parse_bib(bib_path)
articles <- sorted_entries(bib[vapply(bib, is_article, logical(1))])
communications <- sorted_entries(bib[vapply(bib, is_communication, logical(1))])

render_table <- function(entries) {
  rows <- vapply(entries, entry_text, character(1))
  paste0(
    "<table class=\"caption-top\">",
    "<colgroup>",
    "<col style=\"width: 9%\">",
    "<col style=\"width: 28%\">",
    "<col style=\"width: 35%\">",
    "<col style=\"width: 28%\">",
    "</colgroup>",
    "<thead><tr><th>Year</th><th>Authors</th><th>Title</th><th>Venue</th></tr></thead>",
    "<tbody>",
    paste(rows, collapse = "\n"),
    "</tbody></table>"
  )
}

software_specs <- data.frame(
  package = c(
    "survalis", "survdnn", "funcml", "unsurv", "tvrmst",
    "mcstatsim", "missCforest", "mimar", "functionals",
    "CEACT", "testflow", "missknn"
  ),
  link = c(
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=survalis",
    "https://github.com/ielbadisy/survdnn",
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=funcml",
    "https://github.com/ielbadisy/unsurv",
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=tvrmst",
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mcstatsim",
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=missCforest",
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mimar",
    "https://github.com/ielbadisy/functionals",
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=CEACT",
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=testflow",
    "https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=missknn"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

software_rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(software_specs)), function(i) {
  pkg <- software_specs$package[i]
  cit <- citation(pkg)
  pkg_title <- clean_tex(cit[[1]]$title)
  short_title <- sub(paste0("^", pkg, ":\\s*"), "", pkg_title, ignore.case = TRUE)
  bibtex <- paste(capture.output(toBibtex(cit)), collapse = "\n")
  paste0(
    "<tr>",
    "<td><code>", html_escape(pkg), "</code></td>",
    "<td>", html_escape(short_title), "</td>",
    "<td><a href=\"", html_escape(software_specs$link[i]), "\">Source</a></td>",
    "<td><details><summary>Official BibTeX</summary><pre><code>",
    html_escape(bibtex),
    "</code></pre></details></td>",
    "</tr>"
  )
}, character(1))

cat(render_table(articles))

cat("\n\n### Software\n\n")
cat(
  "<table class=\"caption-top\">",
  "<colgroup>",
  "<col style=\"width: 12%\">",
  "<col style=\"width: 36%\">",
  "<col style=\"width: 12%\">",
  "<col style=\"width: 40%\">",
  "</colgroup>",
  "<thead><tr><th>Package</th><th>Title</th><th>Link</th><th>Official citation</th></tr></thead>",
  "<tbody>",
  paste(software_rows, collapse = "\n"),
  "</tbody></table>",
  sep = ""
)

cat("\n\n### Communications\n\n")
cat(render_table(communications))
```
